data.body:
_Also called: Radiofrequency, RF surgery, Radiosurgery_

Electrosurgery at very high frequency (500-4000 kHz) giving precise cutting/coagulation with little lateral heat damage.

## Types / variants
- Cut mode (pure wave): skin tags, naevi, cysts, shave of xanthelasma, verruca plana
- Cut-and-coagulate (blended): curettage, SK, keloids, warts, BCC, Bowen's, SCC, Paget's, debulking rhinophyma, large pyogenic granuloma
- Coagulation mode: pyogenic granuloma, haemangioma, telangiectasia

## Uses / indications
- Same as electrocautery, with choice of mode

## Viva points & tips
- Advantages: less lateral spread, better scars, less infection, easier bleeding control
- Disadvantages: expensive, fragile costly probes
